name: Regina
requestOutcomes: See city record requestsAndEndpointChecks. Official City of Regina ArcGIS metadata and a bounded anonymous Taxweb point query were retrieved. The query returned one polygon with safe OBJECTID-only properties.

qualification.reason: The City of Regina Taxweb service provides a verified public polygon-plus-OBJECTID response, but serial review must qualify canonical parcel semantics, coverage and adapter safety before runtime admission.

scopeLimits: One bounded point query is not evidence of complete citywide coverage or absence outside the returned polygon.
The exact WUP point was preserved in latitude/longitude order; only the request geometry was transformed to EPSG:26913.
No raw source-specific attribute set was retained; the ignored cache contains the unchanged response for evidence.
Address, assessed-value, account, owner, contact, titleholder, personal, tax and certificate/title fields were not requested or retained.
No credentials, private tokens, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, or TLS-verification exception were used.
Packet completion records research only; it is not source integration or runtime admission.
uncertainty: The service is an official municipal tax-parcel viewer and returned a polygon using OBJECTID, but the OpenData/Parcels service exposes an ASSESSMENT_REGIONS layer and the Taxweb service's parcel refresh/coverage semantics are not independently established here.
